posts.subject: ttt-kirbycity-v1_criticism
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello M8s




i made this post because of the new map that got added recently,
(ttt-kirby city-v1) its over all not a bad map, there is some good and bad parts about it, but i think we can definitely improve it (if is technically possible).




it's about the T-room which is causing people to complain about the map, its simply too OP, you can be behind a invisible wall and shoot through it with every gun.



we have always this problem with people camping on t rooms with other maps as well but the problem here gets much more bigger because the t room it's just so much more op on this map, and that will causes players to camp there for too long and that will also cause us (admins) more problems.
a lot of TTT players are also having the same opinion as me that the t room should be changed because OP.



My suggestion will be, changing the t room and making it like other maps, that you can only shoot through it with a AWP.



give me your opinion down here
Ich sehe das nicht so. Man kann gebauso gut von der anderen Seite durch sprayen und man kann auch großzügig drum herum gehen.

@Mas0n:
Try suggesting this to @Damon, the creator of the map.
